newsitem.title: USA: Chicago Purchasing Mgrs Jan index fell to 55.9.
newsitem.headline: Chicago Purchasing Mgrs Jan index fell to 55.9.

text.p: The Chicagoland Business Barometer fell to a seasonally adjusted 55.9 in January from a revised 57.1 in December, the Purchasing Management Association of Chicago (PMAC) said on Friday.
An index below 50 signals a slowing manufacturing economy, while a reading above 50 suggests expansion.
The prices paid index rose to 57.4 in January from a revised 52.7 in December.
The employment component of the barometer rose to 51.1 in January from a revised 50.5 in December.
(* indicates components used to calculate index)
The Purchasing Management Association of Chicago said production and new orders continued strong, while inventories remained at neutral and order backlog turned positive.

It noted that employment in January rose to its highest level in 15 months, while prices paid jumped nearly five points as those reporting higher prices doubled. ((Derivatives Desk 312-408-8750;E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com))
